name: Shindou Ayane
source: Touki's older sister and a teacher at Ainoshima Gakuen. Her relationship with him is that of a close-knit one, despite them having been apart for many years, and this is evident in her frequent teasing. She is also acquainted with Kurea, as they have a friendship in addition to their working relationship.
